name: Parameters.exists_unit_mul_relDifferentGen_real
summary: relDifferentGen(P, s) = ∏_{η ≠ ζ(P, s)}(ζ(P, s) − η) over the other primitive roots; each factor ζ(P, s) − ζ(P, s)^{2j+1} becomes real after multiplication by i·conj(ζ(P, s))^{j+1}, a unit of absolute value 1; induct over the factors.

steps.claim: Write Φ_{N₁(P, s)} = ∏_{η primitive}(X − η) = (X − ζ(P, s))·∏_{η ≠ ζ(P, s)}(X − η) over the primitive N₁(P, s)-th roots η in 𝓞_E (ζ(P, s) taken in 𝓞_E, i.e. zetaInt(P, s)).

Induction over the finite sets S of primitive roots other than ζ(P, s): there is c with c̄c = 1 and c·(the derivative at ζ(P, s) of (X − ζ(P, s))∏_{η∈S}(X − η)) = c·∏_{η∈S}(ζ(P, s) − η) real. For S = ∅ take c = 1; the derivative is computed by simp.
Step: a primitive root η = ζ(P, s)^l ∉ S (l prime to N₁(P, s)) and k with k̄k = 1 and k·∏_S(ζ(P, s) − η′) real; find c for S ∪ {η}.
l is odd (l is prime to N₁(P, s) and 2 ∣ N₁(P, s)); write l = 2j + 1.
Take c = i·k·conj(ζ(P, s))^{j+1}, where i ∈ 𝓞_E has i² = −1 and conj(i) = −i (`StablyUnram.exists_i_c₀`; E contains a primitive 5040-th root of unity).

Then c̄c = (−i)·i·k̄k·(ζ(P, s)·conj(ζ(P, s)))^{j+1} = 1, and c·(ζ(P, s) − ζ(P, s)^{2j+1})·∏_S = i·(ζ(P, s)^{−j} − ζ(P, s)^{j})·(k·∏_S) is real, since ζ(P, s)^{−j} − ζ(P, s)^j is purely imaginary (`star_zetaInt_pow_mul`).
